Message:
rbd: get rid of rbd_{get,put}_dev()

The functions rbd_get_dev() and rbd_put_dev() are trivial wrappers
that add no value, and their existence suggests they may do more
than what they do.

Get rid of them.

Reviewed-by: Dan Mick <dan.mick@inktank.com>
